implementation_summary: No saved attribute reads or saved_tensors_hooks. Nonreentrant checkpoint contexts and root metadata hooks expose original/recompute/external registered calls.

A clean native-argument profile freezes all compatible original logical fields in value classes, plus exact backward call ordinal/argument obligations. All-external demanded classes are frozen outside scope; mixed scope is unsupported.

No activation value is cached across updates. Each update creates fresh observer counters/flags and original signatures. Selected consumer requires every original member and class unanimity before accepting comparisons.
Unknown overloads in registered native families, schema/options/order/metadata/count changes, incomplete original/replay fields and missing/duplicate obligations fail closed.

Consumer mutation uses an independent native GELU counter before any candidate fingerprint/native call and unchanged historical Intervention.mutate. Delivery also occurs in disabled and forward-only arms; its journal is separate from legacy injections.

Observing pilot arms must preserve full model/buffer/optimizer/scheduler/cursor/update/RNG state, preclip gradients, registered native calls and fault identity against matched native references. Enforced mismatch must reject before clipping/optimizer and preserve all non-RNG persistent state.

Unsupported/falsified scientific outcomes retain all twelve case denominators, explicit per-arm status and timing blocking. Invalid native execution, parity or injection realization stops with raw partial records; no automatic correction/retry.

Timing iterates the frozen schedule exactly; each of eight pairs contains disabled/checked eight-update arms with two warmups and six measured updates, totaling128. Direct selected_consumer/full_forward_io block ratios form one mean log ratio per Slurm job; no pooled interval is calculated here.

The timed interval charges observer construction, hook/mode setup, canonical copies, hashing, comparisons, pre-gate decision transfer, cleanup and final device synchronization. Full scientific snapshots and JSON serialization occur after that interval. Production profiling cost/counters are retained separately.

The model profile is admitted only against the pinned12-block architecture: per-region/micro/original-and-recompute GELU1, softmax1, LayerNorm2, plus one final external LayerNorm per micro. Pilot counts are48/48/48 forGELU andsoftmax,96insideoriginal/96recompute/4externaloriginal/100backward forLayerNorm; production32 scales to384/384/384 and768/768/32/800.

Exactly one outside LayerNorm backward event per micro must have input/mean/rstd outside bindings (12pilot/96production), each linked to its own micro external logical field and with all class members outside. Full scalar/tensor metadata is frozen by the core; outside shapes/dtype/device are independently checked. Native outside-backward order remains learned; no unique value-class count is assumed.

Missing required model families, counts, graph slots or outside bindings produce INVALID_PROFILE_CENSUS, with rawprofile/compiledplan and explicit expected/observed census retained before raising. Even an uncompiled coherent unsupported profile must first pass the complete raw architecture census; incomplete coverage cannot be relabeled scientificunsupported.

Each profile/cached plan binds admitted source-file maps, historical revision/source pins, lock/native-source identity, actualPython/Torch/CUDA/package versions, runtime environment/visible-device metadata, registry and native schemas. Every checked update recomputes canonical allowed-model config/module/parameter metadata and validates its envelope and registry inside the charged interval. No weights/checkpoint payload, buffer values, optimizer state, cursor, update or RNG enters the graph identity.

Full profiling-call wall time includes rawprofile/arm export and any enabled transient scientific capture. Binding setup and model-census admission costs are reported separately and included in the conservative total profile admission cost; exported profile bytes are explicitly scoped to the profile-arm directory.

All full state/gradient comparisons and rejection protections are persisted before parity assertions. Each completed timing pair writes its comparison and aggregate timing record before a potential parity failure.

Timing results explicitly distinguish128 timed-arm updates,1 production-profile update and129 total update attempts. The original updates_executed128 field is labeled timed-arms-only for compatibility.
